title: Direction of Motion: Retreat
body: Consider a Cartesian system and let $$\hat{i}$$ point to the east, $$\hat{j}$$ point to the north, and $$\hat{k}$$ point vertically upwards. A convoy moves with velocity $$\vec{v$$} $$=$$ $$\left(4.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}\right)\hat{i$$} + $$\left(3.0\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}\right)\hat{j$$} + $$\left(0.1\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}\right)\hat{k}$$. $$If$$ $$the$$ $$convoy$$ $$had$$ $$to$$ $$retreat$$, $$in$$ $$what$$ $$geographic$$ $$direction$$ $$would$$ $$it$$ $$be$$ $$moving$$?
